content.description_seo: All Because He Asked is an Orange County, California wedding videography and livestreaming studio founded around 2007-2008 by Jamie Hobert, a UCLA film graduate with a broadcast-television editing background. The six-person team covers weddings across Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Santa Barbara, and Napa, plus past destination weddings in states like Hawaii, Wyoming, and Rhode Island. Alongside traditional wedding films and photography, the studio offers live streaming with multiple cameras, drone intros, and network-bonded internet for connection reliability, and has been a repeat "Best of The Knot" winner across nine consecutive years, including a specific 2021 award for live stream videography.
content.one_line_summary: Long-running Orange County wedding videography studio (est. ~2007) offering multi-camera livestreaming alongside cinematic wedding films; 9-time "Best of The Knot" winner.

Born in Massachusetts, he grew up in Orange County, lived in LA for 15 years and is now back in the OC.'
